Free, hands-on tech workshops are coming to the Chicago Public Library this November and December at the Uptown and Mayfair branches. 

We have two workshops for building and publishing your first web page and an introductory class on AI literacy + safety. 

No prior programming experience required; bring your curiosity (and a laptop if you have one, though library access is available).

RSVP here: https://linktr.ee/codingkinetics
